sources.title: GitHub - Chtholly17/EpiFoundation_dev
sources.snippet: EpiFoundation is a transformer-based foundation model for single-cell multi-omics data integration, designed to learn representations from paired ATAC-seq and RNA-seq data. This repository contains code for pretraining, finetuning, and evaluation of the model.
